Corncob Design Language AI integration contract

Primary rules

1. Default to Corncob classes with vanilla HTML and JavaScript. When the target is React, follow the React generation section instead of hand-writing wrapper internals.
2. Generate markup only for components.json entries with implemented: true. Planned components have no canonical example.
3. Use the Corncob grid for page and section layout unless a component page documents a different internal layout.
4. Start from the canonical component code before adding enhancements.
5. Preserve documented class names, child order, and required relationships.
6. Use the grid around structured components instead of rewriting their internal DOM.
7. Always set button type to button, submit, or reset.

Default layout

Use this structure by default for general page composition:

<main class="corn-main corn-container">
  <div class="corn-row">
    <section class="corn-col-12">...</section>
  </div>
</main>

Use responsive spans with:

- corn-col-sm-*
- corn-col-md-*
- corn-col-lg-*
- corn-col-xl-*
- corn-col-xxl-*

Canonical before enhancement workflow

1. Find the canonical component example in components.json or the component docs page.
2. Skip any catalog entry with implemented: false.
3. Emit the documented markup exactly.
4. Replace placeholder text, links, icons, and content.
5. Place the component within the Corncob grid if page layout is needed.
6. Add optional enhancements only after the canonical component code is correct.

Avoid

- inventing wrapper elements around required component children
- building a second custom grid system for normal layouts
- replacing canonical Corncob structure with a second layout system or utility CSS framework
- in React, rebuilding a Corn* component's internal DOM with raw corn-* classes
- changing direct child order for documented components such as headers
- generating corn-card, corn-tabs, corn-table, corn-alert, or corn-avatar markup
- omitting the type attribute on buttons

Button-specific rules

- Always include type="button", type="submit", or type="reset".
- The native default is submit and can submit forms unexpectedly.

Toggle-specific rules

- Use fieldset.corn-toggle-group with a legend and keep aria-labelledby linked to the legend id.
- Use one shared radio name across toggle options so selection is mutually exclusive.
- Keep unique input ids matched by label for attributes.
- Use only documented size modifiers: corn-toggle--xs, corn-toggle--sm, corn-toggle--md, corn-toggle--lg, corn-toggle--xl.
- For icon toggles, keep icons inside labels and provide aria-label on .corn-icon.
- Apply disabled directly on input elements.

Slider-specific rules

- Wrap in corn-slider; the size modifier goes on the same wrapper element.
- Always include a label with for matching the input id.
- Always include min, max, and value attributes on the range input.
- Use only documented size modifiers: corn-slider--xs, corn-slider--sm, corn-slider--md, corn-slider--lg, corn-slider--xl.
- Apply disabled directly on the input element.

Select-specific rules

- Wrap in corn-form--item and div.corn-select.
- Use the corn-select custom element, not a native select.corn-select.
- Populate options as native option children in light DOM.
- Pair with a label whose for matches the corn-select id.

Badge-specific rules

- Keep corn-badge--status and corn-badge--content as required children.
- Variants are neutral (default), success, warning, error, and info.
- Size modifier is corn-badge--sm. Do not use corn-badge--primary or corn-badge--danger.

Toast-specific rules

- Place one corn-toast on the page.
- Call addToast({ type, text, icon, duration }) on that element.
- Use toasts for non-critical feedback only.

Structured component example: header

- Required direct children of corn-header:
  - corn-company
  - corn-header--title
  - corn-header--nav
  - corn-header--actions
- Use the grid around the header for placement.
- Do not add custom wrapper containers inside corn-header unless explicitly documented.

Substitutions for planned components

- Card: use corn-panel
- Alert: use corn-message

React generation

Use this path for .jsx, .tsx, and requests that ask for React. Keep the vanilla path for HTML and other non-React output.

Packages

- Components: @bootsmonday/corncob-design-language-react
- Styles, once per app: @bootsmonday/corncob-design-language/style.css
- Peer dependency: React 19. ref is a normal prop.
- The package entry is a client component ('use client'). Import it from a client boundary in the Next.js App Router.
- Catalog field: components.json "react".

Rules

1. Import the Corn* component for an implemented catalog entry. Do not rebuild that component's internal DOM with raw corn-* classes.
2. Keep page and section layout on plain elements: corn-container, corn-row, and corn-col-*.
3. Copy the React example on the component docs page, or the account form on /frameworks/react/, before replacing content.
4. Skip catalog entries with implemented: false. Use CornPanel instead of a card and CornMessage instead of an alert.
5. className is a string. Do not pass a function. Do not invent props.
6. CornButton defaults to type="button". Pass type="submit" or type="reset" when that is the action. Do not add corn-button--primary or corn-button--md. The wrapper omits those defaults.
7. CornCheckboxGroup, CornRadioButtonGroup, and CornToggleGroup copy name only onto direct CornCheckbox, CornRadioButton, or CornToggle children.
8. indeterminate is a CornCheckbox prop. CornRadioButton does not accept it.
9. CornExpandable leaves open uncontrolled when the prop is omitted. Pass open={true} or open={false} to control it.
10. CornSelect children are CornSelectOption elements. Put the visible label in the label prop.
11. status and statusVariant belong on CornTextInput, CornSelect, and CornSlider.
12. CornLink with underline keeps corn-link and adds corn-link--underline.
13. CornPanelMenuItem active sets corn-panel-menu--item--active and aria-current="page".

Canonical React form

import "@bootsmonday/corncob-design-language/style.css";
import {
  CornButton,
  CornTextInput,
  CornCheckbox,
  CornCheckboxGroup,
} from "@bootsmonday/corncob-design-language-react";

export function AccountForm() {
  return (
    <form>
      <CornTextInput
        label="What is your name?"
        placeholder="Enter Full Name..."
        status="Helper Text"
      />
      <CornCheckboxGroup legend="Options" name="example">
        <CornCheckbox>Checkbox One</CornCheckbox>
        <CornCheckbox defaultChecked>Checkbox Two</CornCheckbox>
      </CornCheckboxGroup>
      <CornButton type="submit">Save</CornButton>
      <CornButton variant="secondary">Cancel</CornButton>
    </form>
  );
}

Public wrappers

- CornButton, CornButtonBar, CornBadge
- CornTextInput, CornSelect, CornSelectOption, CornSlider
- CornCheckbox, CornCheckboxGroup, CornRadioButton, CornRadioButtonGroup, CornToggle, CornToggleGroup
- CornMessage, CornMessageStatus, CornMessageContent, CornMessageTitle
- CornModal, CornModalHeader, CornModalContent
- CornExpandable, CornExpandableSummary, CornExpandableContent, CornAccordion
- CornPopover, CornPopoverTrigger, CornPopoverContent, CornTooltip, CornToast
- CornHeader and its company, title, nav, and actions parts
- CornFooter and its intro, content, section, social, and copyright parts
- CornPanel, CornPanelMenu, CornPanelMenuItem, CornPanelMenuSubmenu
- CornLink, CornLinkList, CornFormItem
